description: Model foundation: create agentcore/claim_model.py (Master Claim Form + provenance envelope, jurisdiction config, decomposed RiskBreakdown, coverage/billing enums, AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES, factories, deterministic mapper/jurisdiction/billing helpers) and wire it into protocol.py via re-export plus two additive ClaimWorkflowState dict fields. This is the dependency root for every later feature. Design §3, §4, §5, §8.5. Depends on nothing; blocks FEAT-002..005.
steps: Create backend/agentcore/claim_model.py. Define FieldStatus (EXTRACTED/MISSING/CONFLICT/VERIFIED/LOW_CONFIDENCE), ConflictingValue, FieldProvenance (field, value, source_document, page, confidence, status, conflicts, note) per design §4.1 with ConfigDict(extra='ignore').

Add section models (design §4.2): ClaimInfo, Patient, Policy, Provider, Hospitalization, Clinical, ProcedureItem/Procedures, InvestigationItem/Investigations, MedicationItem/Medications, BillingLine/Billing (with calculated_total, submitted_total, billing_difference, flag, currency), DocPresence, SupportingDocuments. Scalars are FieldProvenance; lists carry list_status: FieldStatus.
Add status enums owned by the model (design §4.3): PolicyStatus, CoverageStatus, BillingFlag.
Add top-level MasterClaimForm (design §4.4) with claim_id, jurisdiction, all 12 sections, generated_at, schema_version, and methods all_fields()/missing_fields()/conflict_fields().

Add Jurisdiction enum + JurisdictionProfile and infer_jurisdiction(raw_text, extracted_currency) per design §5: INR/₹/+91 → IN (npi_required=False), USD/$+ZIP/NPI → US (npi_required=True, procedure_coding_required=True), else OTHER; attach requirement flags from the profile table.
Add RiskDimension and RiskBreakdown (design §8.5): documentation/policy/clinical/billing/fraud/overall_review dimensions + blocking_conditions list.

Add factories: build_empty_master_form(claim_id, jurisdiction) (every scalar FieldProvenance status=MISSING, every list list_status=MISSING), field_present/field_missing/field_conflict. Add AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES mapping AgentRole.MEDICAL_EXPERT -> 'Clinical Consistency Agent' (and the other roles' display names).

Avoid import cycles: redefine the two confidence thresholds locally (0.80 / 0.50) and import now_utc/new_id lazily inside functions; claim_model must NOT import AgentFinding/AgentMessage from protocol. Add a _band_from_score helper (lowMax 0.3, mediumMax 0.6) yielding only low|medium|high.

Edit backend/agentcore/protocol.py: append a `from .claim_model import (...)` re-export block at the bottom so `from .protocol import MasterClaimForm` works; extend __all__ with the re-exported names. Add `master_form: dict[str, Any] | None = None` and `risk_breakdown: dict[str, Any] | None = None` to ClaimWorkflowState (plain dicts — do NOT import claim_model types into the state class). Do NOT change AgentFinding or AgentMessage.
acceptance_criteria: `d:\ClaimBlitz\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import agentcore.claim_model"` (cwd backend) succeeds with no import error.
`python -c "from agentcore.protocol import MasterClaimForm, RiskBreakdown, JurisdictionProfile, build_empty_master_form, AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES"` (cwd backend) succeeds.
build_empty_master_form(...) returns a form whose every scalar FieldProvenance has status==MISSING and every list list_status==MISSING.
infer_jurisdiction with an INR/₹ text returns jurisdiction IN with npi_required False.
The existing 5 backend tests still pass (no regression from protocol.py changes).
verification: d:\ClaimBlitz\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import agentcore.claim_model; from agentcore.protocol import MasterClaimForm, RiskBreakdown" (cwd backend) — exits 0.
findings:
LANDED (all FEAT-001 acceptance + verification green: existing 5 backend tests pass; both import checks exit 0; build_empty_master_form all-MISSING invariant holds; infer_jurisdiction INR->IN with npi_required False).

NEW MODULE: backend/agentcore/claim_model.py. protocol.py re-exports its symbols at the BOTTOM and ClaimWorkflowState gained `master_form: dict[str, Any] | None = None` and `risk_breakdown: dict[str, Any] | None = None` (plain dicts, no claim_model types imported into the state class). AgentFinding/AgentMessage untouched.

EXPORTED SYMBOLS (importable from BOTH agentcore.claim_model and agentcore.protocol): FieldStatus, ConflictingValue, FieldProvenance, PolicyStatus, CoverageStatus, BillingFlag, ClaimInfo, Patient, Policy, Provider, Hospitalization, Clinical, ProcedureItem, Procedures, InvestigationItem, Investigations, MedicationItem, Medications, BillingLine, Billing, DocPresence, SupportingDocuments, Jurisdiction, ClaimStandard (alias of Jurisdiction), JurisdictionProfile, infer_jurisdiction, MasterClaimForm, RiskDimension, RiskBreakdown, AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES, field_missing, field_present, field_conflict, build_empty_master_form. Also from claim_model only: HIGH_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD, LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD, _band_from_score.

FACTORY SIGNATURES:
- build_empty_master_form(claim_id: str, jurisdiction: JurisdictionProfile) -> MasterClaimForm. Produces every scalar FieldProvenance status=MISSING (56 scalar fields total) and procedures/investigations/medications list_status=MISSING, billing.flag=INSUFFICIENT_DATA, policy.policy_status=MISSING_DOCUMENT, all supporting_documents present=False/status=MISSING. generated_at via lazily-imported protocol.now_utc(); schema_version='1.0'.
- field_missing(field: str) -> FieldProvenance (value None, source/page None, confidence 0.0, status MISSING).
- field_present(field: str, value, *, source_document=None, page=None, confidence=0.0, note=None) -> FieldProvenance. Status derived: confidence>=0.50 -> EXTRACTED else LOW_CONFIDENCE. (Does NOT auto-assign VERIFIED; VERIFIED is reserved for deterministic cross-check / human action per design 4.1 — OCR/Billing code must set it explicitly.)
- field_conflict(field: str, options: list[ConflictingValue]) -> FieldProvenance. Primary value = options[0]; ALL options preserved in conflicts[] (nothing discarded); status CONFLICT.
- infer_jurisdiction(raw_text: str | None, extracted_currency: str | None = None) -> JurisdictionProfile. Deterministic (never LLM): INR currency OR text has ₹/INR/+91 -> IN (npi_required=False, procedure_coding_required=False, provider_registration_expected=True); USD/$ WITH an NPI token or US ZIP -> US (both required True); else OTHER (all required False except provider_registration_expected=True). inferred_from is one of currency:INR|currency:USD|content|default.

SHAPES:
- FieldProvenance{field:str, value:Any|None, source_document:str|None, page:int|None, confidence:float 0-1, status:FieldStatus, conflicts:list[ConflictingValue], note:str|None}. ConfigDict(extra='ignore').
- ConflictingValue{value, source_document, page, confidence}.
- RiskDimension{name:str, score:float 0-1, band:str (low|medium|high), drivers:list[str], blocking:bool}.
- RiskBreakdown{documentation_risk, policy_risk, clinical_risk, billing_risk, fraud_risk, overall_review_risk (all RiskDimension), blocking_conditions:list[str]}. RiskDimension/RiskBreakdown have NO defaults for the required dimension fields — Risk agent must build all six RiskDimension objects.
- MasterClaimForm methods: all_fields()->list[FieldProvenance] (recursive over sections incl. list line-items), missing_fields()->list[str] (dotted paths), conflict_fields()->list[str].
- _band_from_score(score): low if <=0.3, medium if <=0.6, else high (3 bands only; critical collapses to high). /process (FEAT reading risk) should use overall_review_risk.band, falling back to _band_from_score.

DEVIATIONS / THINGS TO KNOW:
- Import-cycle guard: claim_model has NO top-level import from protocol (not even AgentRole). AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES is exposed via module-level __getattr__ that lazily imports AgentRole and caches the AgentRole-keyed dict; build_empty_master_form imports now_utc lazily inside the function. The ONLY import-time edge is protocol -> claim_model (protocol's bottom re-export). Importing agentcore.claim_model first also works (it pulls protocol, which finishes then re-exports).
- ClaimStandard is exported as a straight alias of Jurisdiction (design listed both names; same enum).
- Dotted-path field names used by field_missing in the empty form follow <section>.<attr> e.g. 'patient.name', 'billing.submitted_total', 'claim_info.claim_id'. source_documents on ClaimInfo and 'other' on SupportingDocuments are plain lists, not FieldProvenance.
- AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES maps every AgentRole; MEDICAL_EXPERT -> 'Clinical Consistency Agent', OCR -> 'OCR/Extraction Agent', others '<Title> Agent'.
- NOT done here (out of scope, for later FEATs): OCR mapper/billing compute, supervisor threading of master_form/risk_breakdown, Risk agent producing RiskBreakdown, any agent/route/schema/frontend edits.
